scope: Hashes and sizes of the retained release-candidate artifacts associated with the reported measurements. These are not finalized replacement-ceremony artifacts.

fieldDefinitions.sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of the complete file bytes, recomputed from the retained local file. This is not a domain-separated canonical-JSON manifest or transcript hash.
fieldDefinitions.bytes: Exact file length in bytes at inspection.
fieldDefinitions.filename: Artifact basename; no private source directory is disclosed.
fieldDefinitions.bundled: Whether the complete artifact is distributed in this reference package.
fieldDefinitions.checks: Results of the dated artifact inspection, not additional experimental participants, proof trials, or polls.

setup.description: The retained vote and tally manifests describe an internal, single-contributor release-candidate setup for devnet/internal testing. Their setup metadata records no public-randomness finalization.

laterContributionVerification.scope: Separate read-only checks of the retained round-three replacement contribution outputs against their corresponding R1CS and public powers-of-tau files. These outputs were not the keys used for the reported measurements.
laterContributionVerification.limitations: These checks do not establish contributor independence, secure erasure of secret randomness, public-randomness finalization, deployment, or independent review. The checked artifacts and full verification output are not bundled.

limitations: These hashes identify retained files; they do not establish circuit correctness, honest setup, secure erasure of setup randomness, or the provenance of a deployed service.
The underlying files are not bundled, so reviewers cannot recompute these artifact hashes or run their proof checks from this package alone.
Later contribution outputs are separate from the artifacts used for the reported measurements. Their existence does not establish a finalized or deployed replacement setup.
The later contribution records do not establish three independent contribution groups.
